# Client onboarding checklist

Client checklist: contract signed, client contacts listed, client access granted. Onboarding checklist item one: the client names one decision maker. Onboarding checklist item two: the client agrees to the invoice schedule. Keep the onboarding checklist short, the client has no patience for a long checklist.
